title: Listing Quality Program Note — Guest-Rating Cut to the Short-Stay Share (Listings)
content:
# Guest-Rating Cut to the Short-Stay Share

*Listing quality program note, Roamhaven Listings.*

When the short-stay cleaning fee of a listing is saved, the quality assessments with outcome **warning** recorded on the listing within the last six months (fewer than six whole months before the day of the save) are counted:

| Warning outcomes recorded on the listing in that window | Taken off the listing's short-stay share |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 0.20 |
| exactly 1 | 0.10 |
| none | nothing |

Only the warning outcome is counted; pass, not-assessed and suspension outcomes are not warnings.

## Cases (hypothetical assessment histories)

| Assessments recorded on the listing in the last six months | Warnings counted | Guest-rating cut |
|---|---|---|
| warning, warning | 2 | 0.20 |
| warning, pass | 1 | 0.10 |
| pass, pass | 0 | nothing |
| suspension | 0 | nothing |
